expected_cost: Two full metadata/source closures around the prior 144-second construction and 89-second verification, plus authenticated original-paragraph checks. No new data acquisition or model compute.
metrics: all source units, occurrences, terminal reasons and annotation denominators
proposed target count, source/author/components and exact original input verification
strict #49 retained subset versus newly isolated under a different consumption scope
fresh complete history closure and reverse replay, including all author/article/input/text boundaries
outputs: Append-only/write-once unit decisions, original-slot/target terminals, exact consumption receipts and an isolated-for-dry-run-only subset. Original training_eligible/independent_gold_eligible remain false. No admission or replacement of existing splits.

policy.consumer: Only source_verification is enabled. Training, body pretraining, numeric cache reuse, model inference and checkpoint reuse are forbidden by this trial contract. Integration/adoption requires a separately frozen policy and provenance chain.
policy.content_quarantine: All paragraph/exact-sentence/near-sentence/real-input components touching any historical node. Same .8 threshold, no character-length exceptions. The full original 833600-node inventory, including old unused train-pool bridges, participates.
policy.context: Exact previous 8..64 chars and full target remain in one allowed original paragraph. No stitching across removed text, guessed readings, context expansion or future model input.
policy.identity_quarantine: All source/input components touching any historical node, using article, author and real input equality.
policy.postcheck: Rebuild all original relations afresh on the proposed node population. Never merely filter old representative edges after deleting nodes. Reject publication if any proposed target touches history.
policy.proposed_graph: All unchanged historical nodes plus only nonquarantined source coverage and provisional new annotation rows. Old unused train-pool nodes stay in the original inventory/taint analysis, not in the declared consumed dataset.
policy.unit: One literal original paragraph identified by article_id and paragraph_hash. Repeated identical occurrences in one work share a decision; source revision and occurrence coordinates are still verified per record.
policy.unknown: Missing coverage, revision, source position, undecidable or malformed provenance is not permitted.
